name: v3-partial-effects
title: v3.0 partial-effect pipeline, predictive video invert, self-learning rules, extension prep
description: v3.0: canvas/WebGL partial-inversion and arbitrary-effect pipeline (chroma-key, luminance-mask, PiP delivery), predictive video inversion (rVFC same-frame switching + learned timeline segments), self-learning element rules from user corrections, reusable UI component library, browser-storage preference adapter (cloud-sync ready) with storage manager, file:// support, more media elements (canvas/poster/shadow DOM), and browser-extension scaffolding with CRX CI and auto-publish.
